title: "Ignoring a topic ... package not found" and "has unknown type" in ros2 bag with custom messages: sourcing, MCAP, half-sourced workspaces and changed definitions, measured
excerpt: Why ros2 bag record skips a custom message topic and ros2 bag play ignores it: the shell has not sourced the workspace. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical with sqlite3 and MCAP, plus half-sourced paths, changed .msg files, rosbag2_py and package.xml checks.
